title: Network Engineer
description:
Location:
This is a 100% onsite position based in Los Angeles, California.

Position Overview:
The Network Engineer I provides IT infrastructure engineering for network and infrastructure upgrades,
changes, troubleshooting, relocation and migrations specializing in advanced Cisco and other vendors
solutions.

Responsibilities
Essential Functions
Assists or leads network upgrade activities at customer sites.
● Applies software updates and configurations on Cisco routers or switches.
● Performs quality assurance tests and migration day-1 support for network infrastructure.
● Troubleshoots issues with wired and wireless network infrastructures.
● Participates in site surveys. Creates documentation and reports.
Required Qualifications
● Active Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) certification is required
● Must have hands-on experience with network infrastructure LAN/WAN, Switching, Routing,
Wireless, and Enterprise Networking Infrastructures
● A Valid Driver's License and a reliable vehicle. Driving is a requirement.
● Background check required. Customer may require secondary background check. Work will be
performed at customer sites. Employment is contingent on passing all required checks.
● Strong customer-facing and communication skills.
● Ability to lift equipment up to 40 pounds.
● Ability to work safely on ladders up to 8’.
Nice-To-Have Qualifications:
● Experience with Cisco Routers (ISR & Catalyst Models), Switches (Catalyst 9K Models), Cisco IOS
/ IOS-XE and other technical configurations.
● Advanced Knowledge of network protocols: TCP/IP, EIGRP, OSPF, BGP, DHCP, DNS, STP, VTP, and
/ or DTP.
● Advanced skill in designing, implementing, and troubleshooting Layer 2 and Layer 3 networks,
including VLANs, 802.1q trunking, inter-VLAN routing, and associated protocols.
● Experience with monitoring, alerting and management tools, such as ScienceLogic, Labtech, or
SolarWinds.
● Experience with Cisco IP telephony and wireless systems. Specifically, how to configure networks
to support these technologies.
● Addition Hardware Experience: Cisco legacy fixed and modular Catalyst switches, Cisco firewalls,
Palo Alto Firewalls, Alcatel switches, Client switches, network printers (any vendor), or others.

title: Senior Broadcast - Events Analyst - Non Exempt
description:
This is not a senior role.

Candidate must have live broadcast experience and corporate communication experience.
This role is a blend of AV Tech and AV Operator (with audio board exp)

BROADCAST: Collaborates with business units and external partners to exchange media content and transmit broadcasts, typically covering special events in the field. Develops and coordinates the technical and production infrastructure for external teams and journalists covering broadcast events. Participates in the negotiation of agreements on the exchange and sale of media content.

INTERNAL EVENTS: Collaborates with business units and external partners to support the client's value proposition by planning and successfully executing Opening and Closing Bells and typically covering special events in the field for issuers and non-issuers. Develops and coordinates the technical and production infrastructure for external teams and keeps MarketSite tech team aware of event logistics and changes. Participates in the negotiation of agreements on the exchange and sale of the event space.

EXTERNAL EVENTS: Collaborates with business units and external partners to support CCG objectives through successful planning and execution of global programs and events. Implement events that generate meaningful connections with high level management at listed and prospect companies in order to maintain positive relationships, repair negative relationships and foster new relationships. Produce or sponsor events that provide a platform for the client to be thought leaders in our field by contributing to the regional and global economic conversation. Elevate our listed and prospect companies through event opportunities that promote their brand, provide thought leadership roles to their management and facilitate peer to peer networking. Promote the client through events to ensure listed and prospect companies understand our value proposition. Position responsibilities:

BROADCAST: 1. Applies knowledge base to all Broadcast operations 2. Solid understanding of Broadcast equipment functionality 3. Interact with on-site reports and all internal/external clients 4. Perform Broadcast scheduling needs as required 5. Participates in all duplication responsibilities for Broadcast operations

EVENTS:
1.Responsible for daily bookings of MarketSite opening/closing bell ceremonies. Take a proactive stance in identifying timely and world-wide events that translate in booking opening/closing bell ceremonies and events.
2. Educate the client as a whole on the various ways MarketSite can be utilized to increase exposure and revenue opportunities
3. Leverage creative ways in which clients may use their opening/closing bell or event; coordinate IPO Events and assist IPO team in follow through with Listing Day proposal promises.
4. Raise visibility for the client, its client base and external parties by promoting all facets of MarketSite during client meetings and walk-throughs. Produce revenue.
5. Increase usage of MarketSite for such non-traditional events such as photo shoots for annual reports, tower messages, promotional sidewalk activities, etc

Education required: Bachelors degree

Experience Required: 4 to 5 years
Certifications: Strong event management and writing skills, marketing experience required. Core Skills & Requirement:
Functional knowledge: Requires expanded conceptual knowledge in own discipline and broadens capabilities. Requires some general supervision and/or supervision to apply technical knowledge to our industry/markets.
Business expertise: Understands key business drivers; uses this understanding to accomplish own work.
Leadership: No supervisory responsibilities. Is accountable for developing functional knowledge in order to become a full contributor to the team and its work distribution. Problem solving: Solves problems in straightforward situations; analyzes possible solutions using existing experience, existing standards/ precedents and processes; and will be getting more comfortable using own judgment. Impact: Impacts quality of own work and the work of others on the team; works within standardized guidelines, procedures and practices and meets deadlines as described by supervisor. Interpersonal skills: Exchanges straightforward information with others; asks questions and checks for understanding. Is being more independent in thought; is starting to challenge why and gets involved in more difficult discussions.

Technical Skills & Requirements: Planning and Coordination: Manages time effectively to complete work, tasks, projects, etc. adhering to timelines and priorities. Develops the first draft of detailed project plans, ensuring all milestones are incorporated and timelines are adhered to. Understands how changes to original plans will affect work and project timing and adjusts as needed. Active Listening: Demonstrates attention during discussions, being considerate of others opinions and asking clarifying questions. Monitors own nonverbal behavior when both communicating and listening. Validates understanding of messages by asking probing questions.

Integrates available information and uses routine procedures and processes to make basic, straightforward decisions. Balances making decisions independently versus seeking inputs from others. Considers the short-term implications of decisions and learns how to identify the longer-term implications for the team.
Collaboration: Works in an open and dependable manner with team members. Willingly discloses requested information in a timely manner; provides related information without being asked. Openly communicates with team and manager and at meetings in order to build rapport; asks questions for clarification as needed.

Technology Application: Builds knowledge of market and technology trends and begins to incorporate this knowledge to produce compelling pictures, presentations, etc. Relationship Management: Initiates and develops relationships with key individuals within the team, department and organization. Proactively follows up with contacts and collaborates with others as necessary to advance goals and resolve any unmet expectations. Shares information and invites input from key relationships in internal network, maintaining to advance team goals.

title: Shift Leader - Manager
description:
We are looking for a motivated and hands-on restaurant shift leader to assist in guiding daily operations at our seafood restaurant. This is a career growth opportunity for someone with restaurant experience who is eager to learn, take on new responsibilities, and grow with our company. Cooking experience and some front-of-house management experience are a plus, but a willingness to learn and a strong work ethic are the most important qualities.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Support daily restaurant operations, ensuring cleanliness, great service, and smooth workflow
  • Assist with supervising and front- and back-of-house staff
  • Help maintain food safety, sanitation, and health regulations
  • Assist with inventory management
  • Support menu development
  • Lead pre-shift team huddles and support staff motivation
  • Help enforce restaurant policies and ensure staff accountability
  • Address guest concerns professionally and escalate issues when needed
  • Participate in staff training and onboarding
  • Step in to support service and kitchen roles when necessary
Qualifications:
  • 2–5 years of experience working in a restaurant, in either front-of-house and/or back-of-house roles
  • Some leadership or supervisory experience preferred but not required
  • Cooking experience is a plus
  • Strong communication skills and a passion for hospitality
  • Willingness to learn and grow in a fast-paced environment
  • Comfortable working weekends and guest-facing roles
Why Join Us:
This role is ideal for someone looking to develop their career in restaurant management. You’ll gain hands-on experience in all aspects of restaurant operations and have the chance to grow with the company into a leadership role. Hands on training from experts in the industry, on a daily basis.

Additional information
Base Salary: $60,000–$70,000 Based on Experience + Performance-Based Bonus
Benefits: No benefits
Employment Type: Full-Time | On-Site (Weekend availability required)

title: Payroll Associate - Non Exempt
description:
Job Description:
  • Payroll Associate Assists with performance of calculations for internal and/or external clients and completion of tax reporting or other regulatory filing requirements to ensure compliance with state and national regulations.
  • Assists with the implementation of client plans for the tax and/or regulatory cycle and ensures deadlines are met.
  • Gathers data and documentation to complete standard filings.
  • Determines liabilities, withholdings, and other calculations for internal or external clients.
  • May answer routine questions from clients regarding earnings, deductions, tax and/or regulatory calculations and reporting.
  • Assists with the completion of all payroll processes for the US.
  • Responsible for contributing to the processing of the semi-monthly, monthly, and off cycle payrolls in addition to variable compensation, Stock transactions and Deferred Compensation.
  • Participates in special projects and may lead some special projects that are less complex in nature. No direct reports.
  • Contributes to the achievement of team objectives.
Qualifications:
  • 4-6 years of total work experience is preferred.
  • Degree in Finance or Accounting is preferred.
  • US Payroll processing, Tax reporting and analysis experience preferred.

Additional Information:
  • Duration: Position is temporary for 6 months may lead to permanent based on business need.
  • Hybrid Work Model: 4 days onsite required weekly
  • Rate Range: $25-32/hr. W2 (based on experience)

title: Fund Accountant - Non Exempt
description:
Job Description:
  • The Accountant is accountable to deliver through effective, efficient Sarbanes-Oxley, regulatory compliant finance processes, in accordance with local and consolidated GAAP, useable, accurate and timely financial information from the point of transaction through to financial close and external reporting period (month, quarter, and annual).
  • The individual in this role may be called upon to support a particular line of business, region, or accounting process, as assigned, for any Record to Report (R2R) process from the point of transaction through to the close, consolidation, and financial reporting of business outcomes for enterprise.
  • S/he provides support for the end to end Record to Report accounting processes, required to transform data into information for reporting purposes. This includes: processing of basic general ledger events, financial transactions, as assigned; identifying and analyzing exceptions; and providing support to the department for R2R activities such as audits, the fulfillment of ad hoc requests, and other special project activities, as assigned. For example, prepares and/or posts journal entries to the general ledger accounts; and reconciles g/l activity to ensure that the trial balance includes expected transactions and reflects the correct balances.
  • S/he prepares also performs reconciliations of accounts or financial data.
  • The individual in this role may be called upon to perform other accounting activities, as requested, such as performing basic accruals, posting adjustments, or other less complex accounting activities.
  • In addition, supports the day to day capture of performance metrics at the functional, team and individual level, and participates in rotating assignments across lines of business, legal entities and geographies to grow depth of understanding of the various lines of business, and the unique attributes of the legal entity, regulatory, and in-country requirements, over time.

In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:
  • Develop and extend collaborative working relationships with senior clients, technology, and operational support areas, effectively resolving problems/issues and identifying service improvement areas.
  • Collaborate across various teams including Trades, Reconciliation, Valuation, Client Onboarding, and Technology Support to deliver superior service.
  • Foot ledger to the subsidiary ledger of all funds before converting onto accounting platform.
  • Standardize new client reporting for intake within the accounting platform utilizing approved technology.
  • Make necessary static data mapping for further validation of reports.
  • Review and work with client and third parties to improve quality of client instructions.
  • Determining the net asset value (NAV) for assigned funds for each measurement cycle.

Required Experience:
  • Relevant work experience in accounting or finance.
  • Strong written and oral communications skills in English.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in accounting/finance or the equivalent combination of education and experience is required.
  • 3-6 years of total work experience.
  • Self-motivator with a strong work ethic, initiative, critical and strategic problem-solving skills.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organization skills and must be able to quickly gather and analyze data.
  • Excellent multi-tasking skills with the ability to thrive in a dynamic working environment.
  • Flexibility to support market hours and do some after-hours work when necessary, including working on weekends

Preferred Experience:
  • Experience with accounting applications such as PeopleSoft.

Additional Information:
  • Duration: 6 month contract opportunity
  • Hybrid Work Model: 4 days onsite required weekly in Lake Mary, FL office
  • Shift: Shift (1) 8:00AM - 4:00PM; (2) 9:00AM - 6:00PM; (3) 10:00AM - 7:00PM
  • Rate Range: $29-34/hr. W2 (based on experience)

title: Project Accountant
description:
Job Description:
  • Collaborate with Project Managers to track cost and ensure accurate accounting of project specific expenditures and revenues
  • Continuously review and improve financial management processes
  • Invoicing to clients using Sage 300, various SAP systems, and customer supplied AIA forms within monthly billing deadlines
  • Lien waiver management
  • Responsible for project closeout documents
  • Understanding of WIP schedules
  • Change order management
  • Review invoice submissions from subcontractors to ensure compliance with contract provisions and budgetary limits
  • Compile and analyze job cost reports
  • Compile cost impacts based on delays in project schedules
  • CCIP and OCIP project enrollments and audits
  • Assist with AIR Collections
  • Ability to negotiate contracts
  • Assist with yearend closing
  • Miscellaneous projects as requested by management
  • Accounts Payable backup when needed
  • Backup to Payroll Manager when needed

Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree in accounting or finance
  • Strong analytical skills are required
  • Attention to detail is a must
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment

Additional Details:
  • Location: Onsite position based in Lebanon, NJ
  • Salary Range: $60,000 - $80,000 per year
